# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment facts generated for the latest versioned report.

## Available Documents

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) - High-level architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) - Dependency categories, version risks, and test dependency inventory.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint inventory, communication patterns, and sequence flow.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, entity relationships, repository methods, and sensitivity notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime profiles, secrets workflow, and version inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) - Core domain entities, key workflows, and business-rule sequence diagrams.

> Note: The .NET upgrade assessment scenario output is not included because the required MCP assessment tools were unavailable in this environment.
